resources_validated: export zip on Shawn's disk, hash in the frame

steps.do: eng/Build-RoundTable.ps1 -Export <zip> reads the export and writes eng/round-table/transcript.json (source, speaker, addressee, trail, seed, verbatim text)
steps.proof: block count equals the 8 openers counted in the export; every speaker is a company.json title; every named trail exists
steps.must_fail: a speaker not in company.json or a trail folder that does not exist stops the build

steps.do: the same script renders docs/round-table.html from eng/round-table/template.html plus transcript.json plus company.json, byte-stable, with no timestamps
steps.must_fail: a hand edit of the page differs from a fresh render

steps.do: eng/Test-RoundTable.ps1 checks speaker, trail, seed, body, play button per block, controls, filters, no absolute link, no external request, completeness, drift and DocFX wiring
steps.proof: each check passes on the real page
steps.must_fail: 13 mutations of the page or the DocFX files, each expected to fail one named check, are run before the real page

steps.do: add docs/round-table.md, a resource entry in docs/docfx.json and a toc entry in docs/toc.yml
steps.must_fail: S3 mutations without the resource entry or the toc entry fail

steps.do: run tools/build.ps1 (must change nothing), tools/check-queue.ps1, eng/Test-Determinism.ps1, dotnet docfx only if already installed; then /pmcro:commit
steps.must_fail: the S3 harness with the rule switched off reports the mutation as not caught
